name: z-ai/glm-5.3-flash
description: GLM-5.3-Flash is the first native multimodal model in Z.ai's GLM-5 series, a 320B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 18B active parameters that combines sparse and linear attention to cut long-context compute and KV cache. Vision is built into its coding loop, letting it inspect rendered interfaces and GUI feedback for frontend, game and computer-use work, and it also handles office documents and financial research. Z.ai reports it outperforms GLM-5.2; GLM-5.3-FlashX serves it at higher speed.
